limitations.summary: A midpoint_to_destination period pays the mean of the whole monthly pay of the pay level and the destination level: base salary and every active fixed allowance (an allowance of one level counts as zero on the other); the base takes the rest of the rounded mean of the totals. A CCNL whose text leaves the averaged components open carries its own limitation <ccnl_id>/apprenticeship_midpoint_components, recorded on the midpoint path.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.apprenticeship.rules._midpoint_chain; CCNL Aziende Termali Federterme 2024-2027 Art. 13 lett. g ('maggiorato di un importo pari al 50% del differenziale previsto tra il 5° e il 6° livello'); tests/knowledge/ccnl_engine/apprenticeship/rules/test_midpoint.py
limitations.remediation: Resolved: CCNLs whose midpoint components are unsourced are tracked by their own apprenticeship_midpoint_components limitation.

limitations.summary: Apprentices accrue only the CCNL apprentice-specific seniority increment, paid in full: the apprenticeship percentage no longer reduces it a second time. A CCNL that declares no apprentice amount pays none and carries its own open limitation <ccnl_id>/apprentice_seniority, recorded when the level pays matured increments.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.compensation.element.rules and MonthlyPayChain.scaled_for_apprenticeship; apprentice amounts as sourced in the CCNL notes (acconciatura-estetica 2024 renewal Art. 25: 6 EUR; tessile-moda-artigianato 2024 renewal: 6 EUR; panificazione Art. 34-bis 'esclusi gli apprendisti' and 2024 renewal: 10 EUR; comunicazione-artigianato 2024 renewal: 10 EUR; legno-lapidei-artigianato 2024 renewal: 8 EUR); tests/knowledge/ccnl_engine/apprenticeship/rules/test_seniority.py
limitations.remediation: Resolved: the remaining CCNLs are tracked by their own apprentice_seniority limitation.

limitations.summary: A percentage apprenticeship reduces every fixed allowance whose apprenticeship_pct_relevant flag the data leaves at its default, together with the base salary. Whether the CCNL applies the percentage to that allowance (an EDR, a contingenza, a function allowance) was not sourced. The run is affected when such an allowance is in the apprentice's pay.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.apprenticeship.rules (percentage track chain)
limitations.remediation: Source, for each CCNL, the elements the apprenticeship percentage applies to and set apprenticeship_pct_relevant on every allowance; the limitation then no longer applies to its runs.

limitations.summary: The INPS share of a sick day is computed on the INPS daily base of the episode, on the days INPS pays (the weekdays of an operaio, every day but the national holidays on a Sunday of an impiegato, point 7.3 of INPS circ. 134368/1981): the retribuzione media globale giornaliera of the month before the illness (INPS circ. 134368/1981 point 11; circ. 55/2024 Allegato 1), whole or partial month, impiegato or operaio, or for the lavoratori dello spettacolo the average pay of the last 40 daily contributions, capped for a fixed-term worker (INPS circ. 132/2021 par. 2.4). The base is a fact of the payroll history the episode states (SicknessEpisode.inps_base).
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.sickness.base.rules (daily base); ccnl_engine.sickness.pay.handlers (INPS share of a sick day)
limitations.remediation: Resolved: the INPS share is computed on the base of every regime of the bundle; an episode that states no base the engine can read has the missing_fact issue sickness_inps_base_unknown (fact inps_base), which blocks the run. Tests: tests/mutation/ccnl_engine/sickness/base/test_rules_wiring.py, tests/mutation/ccnl_engine/sickness/base/test_rules.py.

limitations.summary: The CCNL tier and the comporto are counted on the days of one episode and the relapses it continues. A CCNL that sums the sickness of separate episodes over a window (a calendar year, the last three years) can reach a lower tier or the end of the comporto earlier than the engine shows. The run is affected when an earlier episode outside the relapse chain is recorded. A CCNL whose comporto the engine counts over the calendar year (Commercio Art. 186 and the others with comporto_calendar_year) is not affected.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.sickness.day.rules (CCNL tier of a sick day)
limitations.remediation: Add the cumulation window of each CCNL to its sickness rule, with the source, and count the tier and the comporto over it.

limitations.summary: The CCNL sets the comporto (180 days, arts. 61-62 of the operai agricoli e florovivaisti) without saying whether separate episodes are summed or over which window, and the law gives no default: art. 2110 c. 2 c.c. leaves the period to the law, the usages or equity, and Cass. 23596/2018 has the judge set both limits of the comporto per sommatoria by equity. The engine counts the comporto over one episode and its relapses; a judge may sum separate episodes. The run is affected when an earlier episode outside the relapse chain is recorded.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.sickness.issue.handlers (episode limitations)
limitations.remediation: None from the sources: the window is set by a judge case by case; a provincial contract or usage that sets it can be added as the sickness rule of the CCNL.

searched.title: CCNL operai agricoli e florovivaisti 2022-2025, arts. 61-63 (PDF pp. 60-62): 180 days of conservazione del posto, no window.
Verbale di rinnovo 28 maggio 2026, arts. 61-62 (PDF pp. 37-38): the 180 days unchanged, no window.
Art. 2110 c. 2 c.c.: 'decorso il periodo stabilito dalla legge [...], dagli usi o secondo equità'.

Cass. civ. sez. lav. 23596/2018, massima: 'il comporto per sommatoria, ove la contrattazione non lo preveda e non vi siano usi utilmente richiamabili, va determinato dal giudice con impiego della cd. equità integrativa'.

limitations.summary: The run reads a tax ruleset marked provisional: the sources of its year are not published yet (budget law of the year; regional and municipal surtax resolutions), so the values are those of the year before, carried over. Rules in force by statute (the IRPEF brackets of art. 11 and the deductions of art. 13 of the testo unico of D.Lgs. 117/2026) carry over unchanged; any change of the budget law is not applied.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.assurance.ruleset.services.provisional_paths (tax ruleset of the run)
limitations.remediation: Replace each provisional ruleset of the year with the values of its published sources, drop its provisional flag, then resolve this limitation.

awaited.publication: The Legge di bilancio 2027 (Gazzetta Ufficiale, by 31 December 2026) and the regional and municipal IRPEF surtax resolutions of 2027 (MEF, Dipartimento delle Finanze, by the end of March 2027)

limitations.summary: The run reads an INPS ruleset marked provisional: the INPS circulars of its year are not published yet, so the rates, the massimale and the minimale (and the hourly contributions of domestic work) are those of the year before, carried over. The indexed amounts change every January: the carried-over values understate them.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.assurance.ruleset.services.provisional_paths (INPS ruleset of the run)
limitations.remediation: Replace each provisional INPS ruleset of the year with the values of the INPS circulars of the year, drop its provisional flag, then resolve this limitation.

awaited.publication: The INPS circulars on the 2027 contribution rates, massimale, minimale and domestic hourly contributions (published every year between January and February)

limitations.summary: An apprentice whose TFR goes to a pension fund or to the Fondo Tesoreria takes the 0.28-point relief of D.L. 203/2005 art. 8 and no Fondo di garanzia exemption: the 10% apprentice rate of L. 296/2006 art. 1 c. 773 is split by the D.M. 28 marzo 2007 among FPLD 9.01, CUAF 0.11, malattia 0.53, maternità 0.05 and INAIL 0.30, with no Fondo di garanzia share to exempt.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.severance.relief.services; INPS circ. n. 108 of 14 November 2018, par. 3.2, PDF p. 10 (https://www.inps.it/content/dam/inps-site/it/scorporati/circolari-e-messaggi/2018/11/Circolare_397/Allegati/5081_Circolare-numero-108-del-14-11-2018.pdf, sha256 67b393337ceae0a16ffef8047de183a28eb9fc379c8aa33e9d4f3270d188a35e)
limitations.remediation: Resolved: the apprentice rate holds no Fondo di garanzia share, so none is exempted.

limitations.summary: D.L. 463/1983 art. 7 c. 5 keeps the operai agricoli out of the 9.50% minimum daily base, and the run applies no minimum to them. Tabella A of INPS circ. 6/2026 still lists 51.70 for the operai agricoli, 'non soggetto all'adeguamento' of art. 7 c. 1; no source found says whether it is a floor of their contribution base. A base below it may understate the contributions.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.contribution.minimum_base.services.minimum_base_paths; D.L. 463/1983 art. 7 cc. 1 and 5; INPS circ. 6/2026 allegato 1, Tabella A, note (2)
limitations.remediation: Resolved: Tabella A gives the operai agricoli the 51.70, kept by art. 7 c. 5 from the 9.50% adjustment; circ. INPS 43/2026 recalls the legal minimums for the OTI and OTD and gives their part time 58.13 x 6/39 = 8.94. contribution/2026/agricoltura.json holds both as daily_by_category and hourly_categories. Tests: tests/mutation/ccnl_engine/contribution/minimum_base/test_rules.py.

limitations.summary: The INPS indemnity of the leave is computed on the pay of the month before, as the sickness base (art. 23 D.Lgs. 151/2001): an operaio's pay over the days worked or paid with the monthly share of the extra months over 25, a month not worked in full over its days worked or paid; the pay of the month before, its days and the pay of a whole month are facts of the leave, missing when not stated. The run keeps its own pay only when the category or the monthly payments of the CCNL are unknown.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.absence.insured.maternity_base; ccnl_engine.sickness.base.rules.daily_base; INPS circ. 10/1980 par. 2.4 (https://www.inps.it/it/it/inps-comunica/atti/circolari-messaggi-e-normativa/dettaglio.content-fragment-detail.circolari-e-messaggi.1980.01.circolare-numero-10-del-22-1-1980_70.json, sha256 696f273d3aae5b882e2cbf5e97909541d5ed8354fc10f30d001e58508255993d): the maternity base 'è identica a quella da prendere a base per il calcolo dell'indennità giornaliera di malattia'.
limitations.remediation: Resolved: the base of an operaio and of a partial month is the sickness base of the month before.

limitations.summary: The INPS indemnity of the leave is computed on the pay of the month before, as the sickness base (art. 23 D.Lgs. 151/2001): an operaio's pay over the days worked or paid with the monthly share of the extra months over 25, a month not worked in full over its days worked or paid; the pay of the month before, its days and the pay of a whole month are facts of the leave, missing when not stated. The run keeps its own pay only when the category or the monthly payments of the CCNL are unknown.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.absence.insured.maternity_base; ccnl_engine.sickness.base.rules.daily_base; INPS circ. 10/1980 par. 2.4 (https://www.inps.it/it/it/inps-comunica/atti/circolari-messaggi-e-normativa/dettaglio.content-fragment-detail.circolari-e-messaggi.1980.01.circolare-numero-10-del-22-1-1980_70.json, sha256 696f273d3aae5b882e2cbf5e97909541d5ed8354fc10f30d001e58508255993d): the maternity base 'è identica a quella da prendere a base per il calcolo dell'indennità giornaliera di malattia'.
limitations.remediation: Resolved: the base of an operaio and of a partial month is the sickness base of the month before.

limitations.summary: The INPS indemnity of the leave is computed on the pay of the month before, as the sickness base (art. 23 D.Lgs. 151/2001): an operaio's pay over the days worked or paid with the monthly share of the extra months over 25, a month not worked in full over its days worked or paid; the pay of the month before, its days and the pay of a whole month are facts of the leave, missing when not stated. The run keeps its own pay only when the category or the monthly payments of the CCNL are unknown.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.absence.insured.maternity_base; ccnl_engine.sickness.base.rules.daily_base; INPS circ. 10/1980 par. 2.4 (https://www.inps.it/it/it/inps-comunica/atti/circolari-messaggi-e-normativa/dettaglio.content-fragment-detail.circolari-e-messaggi.1980.01.circolare-numero-10-del-22-1-1980_70.json, sha256 696f273d3aae5b882e2cbf5e97909541d5ed8354fc10f30d001e58508255993d): the maternity base 'è identica a quella da prendere a base per il calcolo dell'indennità giornaliera di malattia'.
limitations.remediation: Resolved: the base of an operaio and of a partial month is the sickness base of the month before.

limitations.summary: The days of parental leave beyond the indemnified months are paid 30% when the parent's individual income (ParentalLeaveEvent.individual_income) is below 2.5 times the yearly trattamento minimo di pensione (art. 34 c. 3 D.Lgs. 151/2001); a year whose minimum the INPS has not published yet (2027) pays them nothing.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.absence.insured.parental.rules.allocate; D.Lgs. 151/2001 art. 34 (Normattiva, text in force on 2026-10-30, page sha256 aaf521a98f84e5d33cad1deee74452d789e5c58ec3d1ede4567453d7b7bd3967)
limitations.remediation: Add the trattamento minimo of each new year to the parental rates when the INPS circular publishes it.

awaited.publication: The INPS circular on the trattamento minimo di pensione of 2027 (published every year in January)

limitations.summary: When a rate band or the indemnified months of the parental leave end inside a calendar month, the days of that month are paid in order at the rate of the period each falls in, one day of counter each, the last day what is left of the thirty. INPS attributes the rates to the periods of leave by day, within a month too: circ. 57/2024, example A, gives 30% to 21-31 December 2023 and 80% to 1-20 January 2024, and counts '10 giorni residui' of the further month after 20 days taken.
limitations.source: INPS circ. 57/2024 (example A) and circ. 95/2025; ccnl_engine.absence.insured.parental.handlers
limitations.remediation: Resolved: the rates follow the days of each period, as INPS circ. 57/2024.

limitations.summary: The days of parental leave accrue the 13th and the other extra months in full at the employer's charge: the leave does not reduce them (art. 34 c. 5 D.Lgs. 151/2001), and no source sets a netting of the share the INPS indemnity holds in its base (art. 23 c. 2); by the maintainer's decision of 2026-11-15 the employer pays the whole rateo, as the text reads.
limitations.source: D.Lgs. 151/2001 artt. 23 c. 2 and 34 c. 5; maintainer decision of 2026-11-15; ccnl_engine.absence.insured.parental.handlers
limitations.remediation: Resolved by the decision of 2026-11-15: the employer pays the whole rateo of the extra months.

limitations.summary: A parental leave by the hour follows the national CCNL rule on the hours of a day of leave (art. 32 c. 1-bis D.Lgs. 151/2001, work_rules.parental_hourly), or without one the general criterion of art. 32 c. 1-ter: half the average daily hours a day, two such days a day of leave, no cumulation with the nursing rests on the same day (INPS circ. 152/2015 par. 2.1-2.2). The run records this limitation while the bundle does not record the rule of the CCNL; a company or territorial agreement is the fact local_hourly_agreement of the event.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.absence.insured.parental.hourly.handlers._handle_hourly_parental; INPS circ. 152/2015 (sha256 6e74e62dd50378c23117df7aaca509ab9b8b93e60f99cad23e9c64982fd3734e) par. 2.2; INPS msg. 6704/2015 (sha256 df53a5985edfad727f8f7fcab3c2e21ee70181181ef35194935394157ef12204)
limitations.remediation: Source the collective rules on the leave by the hour of the CCNL (hours of a day of leave, cumulation) and apply them, then resolve this limitation.

limitations.summary: The days of permit under L. 104/1992 art. 33 c. 3 keep the TFR base. Art. 33 c. 4 refers to art. 43 D.Lgs. 151/2001, which applies art. 34 c. 5: the days are paid and counted in the seniority; no primary source states their TFR base, and by the maintainer's decision of 2026-11-15 they stay in it, as payroll practice holds.
limitations.source: L. 104/1992 art. 33 cc. 3-4; D.Lgs. 151/2001 artt. 34 c. 5 and 43; maintainer decision of 2026-11-15; ccnl_engine.absence.insured.permit.handlers
limitations.remediation: Resolved by the decision of 2026-11-15: the permit days stay in the TFR base.

limitations.summary: A notice partly worked pays the share of its calendar days left of the indemnity the CCNL band gives in monthly pays; the CCNL clause read (Federmeccanica Sez. Quarta Tit. VIII Art. 1) states the indemnity of the whole notice only, and practice also measures the rest by 30ths or 26ths of the monthly pay.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.termination.notice.handlers._handle_notice_indemnity; art. 2118 c. 2 c.c. (Normattiva, page sha256 4452820aa5b54831d6c7295a8e1ac8035d9ea4babba3db388188c6101ab4cc3f)
limitations.remediation: Resolved: art. 2118 c. 2 c.c. (https://www.normattiva.it/atto/caricaArticolo?art.versione=1&art.idGruppo=267&art.flagTipoArticolo=2&art.codiceRedazionale=042U0262&art.idArticolo=2118&art.idSottoArticolo=1&art.idSottoArticolo1=10&art.dataPubblicazioneGazzetta=1942-04-04&art.progressivo=0&, sha256 834213e542e77f0f1079835b14c444432e208be59a9d3d4c859ff5ede6c8e11d): 'un'indennità equivalente all'importo della retribuzione che sarebbe spettata per il periodo di preavviso'; a notice partly worked owes the pay of the days left, as the engine computes. How a day of that pay is measured stays the declared residual notice_indemnity_day_measure. Read on 2026-11-15.

limitations.summary: The indemnity is the monthly pays of the CCNL band on the monthly pay of art. 2121 c.c.; the 13th and 14th the notice would have accrued are not added, although art. 2121 counts 'ogni altro compenso di carattere continuativo', so the indemnity may be understated.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.termination.notice.handlers._handle_notice_indemnity; art. 2121 c.c. (Normattiva, page sha256 209f2f9e1b21f1c41b8d413496e3a5abf062616cf6d87f22c01625cbe3bf408f)
limitations.remediation: Resolved: art. 2121 c. 1 c.c. (Normattiva, https://www.normattiva.it/atto/caricaArticolo?art.versione=2&art.idGruppo=267&art.flagTipoArticolo=2&art.codiceRedazionale=042U0262&art.idArticolo=2121&art.idSottoArticolo=1&art.idSottoArticolo1=10&art.dataPubblicazioneGazzetta=1942-04-04&art.progressivo=0, sha256 d0e0175efc4dd4c7e4cc4d8431ed107547531932ccfc6dc5e078b94f0a45e7ec): 'L'indennità di cui all'articolo 2118 deve calcolarsi computando [...] ogni altro compenso di carattere continuativo'. The indemnity carries the rateo of the extra months; read on 2026-11-15.

limitations.summary: The notice indemnity enters the TFR base only when the CCNL puts it there: the Cassazione holds that it is out of it, being referable to a period not worked after the end of the employment, and art. 2120 c. 2 c.c. leaves a different rule to the collective agreement.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.termination.notice.handlers._handle_notice_indemnity; Cass. sez. lav. 19 January 2023 n. 1581, par. 10.2 ('L'indennità di mancato preavviso non rientra nella base di computo del T.f.r. poiché essa non è dipendente dal rapporto di lavoro essendo invece riferibile ad un periodo non lavorato'), citing Cass. 21270/2012, 21216/2009 and 17248/2015 (text reproduced at https://www.studiocerbone.com/?p=471677, page sha256 d87f0d7485c6cb5717ed8b2c706bcbc99f4a05c0b7165c1b7c8ec39e3b905ae1); art. 2120 c. 2 c.c.
limitations.remediation: Resolved: the indemnity is out of the TFR base unless the CCNL notice sets tfr_base true.

limitations.summary: A notice in calendar days is paid at the monthly pay over 30 for each calendar day ('la retribuzione che sarebbe spettata', art. 2118 c. 2 c.c.): no law sets a daily measure, and by the maintainer's decision of 2026-11-15 a calendar day is a thirtieth of the month unless the CCNL sets its own. A CCNL whose daily quota differs records its own limitation.
limitations.source: c.c. artt. 2118-2121; maintainer decision of 2026-11-15; ccnl_engine.termination.notice.handlers._handle_notice_indemnity
limitations.remediation: Resolved by the decision of 2026-11-15: a calendar day of notice is a thirtieth of the monthly pay.

limitations.summary: The daily indemnity of the extraordinary leave is the last monthly pay of fixed and continuous items times the monthly payments of a year, over 365 days (366 in a leap year), as INPS circ. 64/2001 par. 4 sets for a month worked full time; for a vertical part time the circular divides the pay of the month by its paid days, rest days included, which ExtraordinaryLeaveEvent.last_month_paid_days states. A vertical or mixed part time that does not state them is paid on the full-time measure, so its indemnity may be misstated.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.absence.insured.extraordinary.handlers._handle_extraordinary_leave; tests/mutation/ccnl_engine/absence/insured/extraordinary/test_handlers.py; INPS circ. 64/2001 par. 4 ('la retribuzione del mese preso a riferimento (comprensiva della quota parte di tredicesima mensilità, ecc.), se il mese è lavorato a tempo pieno, va moltiplicata per 12 e divisa per 365 giorni (366 se le assenze cadono in un anno bisestile) [...] Se invece nel mese preso a riferimento l'attività è stata svolta in regime di contratto di lavoro a part time verticale, la retribuzione percepita nel mese stesso va divisa per il numero dei giorni retribuiti, compresi quelli festivi o comunque di riposo'; INPS content fragment sha256 de3751ac274d81141df627d3c95b220fbf6bcbafed78fefa4f94871a755c427e); D.Lgs. 151/2001 art. 42 c. 5-ter
limitations.remediation: Resolved: ExtraordinaryLeaveEvent.last_month_paid_days divides the pay of a vertical part time by its paid days (INPS circ. 64/2001 par. 4); a leave that does not state them is paid on the full-time measure with the provisional issue extraordinary_paid_days_unknown, which names the fact.

limitations.summary: The NASpI contribution of the end of an employment that does not state its case (EmploymentPeriod.naspi_case) is read from the cause, the just cause and the contract type alone: a resignation in the protected period of maternity and a mutual agreement before the labour office or on a transfer over 50 km would owe it (INPS circ. 44/2013 par. 1), a collective dismissal would owe 82% for an employer owing the CIGS contribution (L. 205/2017 art. 1 c. 137) and three times without union agreement (L. 92/2012 art. 2 c. 35), the changes of contractor with a social clause and the closures of a construction site of c. 34 would leave it out. The service counts the fixed-term periods before the open-ended contract and leaves out the leave of art. 42 c. 5 D.Lgs. 151/2001 only through EmploymentPeriod.started_on.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.termination.naspi.services.naspi_dismissal; tests/mutation/ccnl_engine/termination/naspi/test_services_wiring.py; L. 92/2012 art. 2 cc. 31-35 (Normattiva, sha256 d40853a1e6c1e20173298f832828aff3e5838ec01aa7994575ed3bd8e1716f6e); INPS circ. 44/2013 (sha256 921fa38bef69508119c546fd0179ceff3e272224bd4ddea8f2e2949e09c89f07); INPS msg. 594/2018 (sha256 f035fc25dc30190d0ef3895fced7b461d6f1b788821f20fdb0bc516d2e7ae500)
limitations.remediation: Resolved: EmploymentPeriod.naspi_case states the cases that owe, leave out or multiply the contribution; an end that could be one and does not state it is decided from its cause alone with the provisional issue naspi_dismissal_case_unknown, which names the fact.

limitations.summary: Two garnishments of the same kind, or two salary assignments, share the measure of their kind (a fifth, or the tenth or seventh of the agente della riscossione) in the order of notification: art. 545 c. 4 c.p.c. sets 'un quinto per i tributi ... ed in eguale misura per ogni altro credito' and art. 5 DPR 180/1950 a cessione 'fino al quinto', but no text read says how two orders of the same kind split the measure, so the later order may be under- or overstated.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.personal_withholding.services.same_kind_paths; art. 545 c.p.c. (Normattiva, page sha256 1fa0acce41c8fa68d80eba137bd4fcbe903016fa97ac4df183cc0ce55897ce66); art. 5 DPR 180/1950 (Normattiva, page sha256 461c2014ffdc7d93ddc0761877b9cd4b4964c256165ef252412a3c38a78a4919)
limitations.remediation: Resolved: art. 553 c. 1 c.p.c. (Normattiva, https://www.normattiva.it/atto/caricaArticolo?art.versione=4&art.idGruppo=93&art.flagTipoArticolo=1&art.codiceRedazionale=040U1443&art.idArticolo=553&art.idSottoArticolo=1&art.idSottoArticolo1=10&art.dataPubblicazioneGazzetta=1940-10-28&art.progressivo=0&, sha256 b41bf831e63fcaacfe95231f9595da5d0e5619c162cc455a80632bba90c147cd): the judge 'le assegna in pagamento [...] ai creditori concorrenti' and 'L'obbligo di pagamento decorre, per il terzo, dalla notifica dell'ordinanza di assegnazione'. The amount each garnishment takes is the fact of its ordinanza: PersonalWithholding.installment, and two garnishments of one kind without it give the missing-fact issue personal_withholding_unassigned. Read on 2026-11-15.

limitations.summary: INPS pays an operaio agricolo a tempo determinato for as many days as the registration in the elenchi of the year before (at most 180 a calendar year) when they are 51, else 30 days with 51 days of the current year before the illness, else none. An episode that does not state SicknessEpisode.agricultural_days is paid by INPS up to the 180 days a year, the 51-day requirements unchecked.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.sickness.issue.rules.fixed_term_fact; tests/mutation/ccnl_engine/sickness/day/test_agricultural.py; INPS, Indennità di malattia e visite mediche di controllo (scheda informativa, aggiornata al 21/09/2026, page sha256 2c123881b7667eed21bc6971e82ea1106f53eb759d5943e7e964227fe7c67a06), Lavoratori dipendenti: quanto spetta; INPS, Guida alla tutela previdenziale della malattia, settembre 2024, p. 4 (sha256 a1e151fbffb42a87a9d93b748dc70ceeeffea1a4f246932d44259aa573144c7b)
limitations.remediation: Resolved: SicknessEpisode.agricultural_days limits the days INPS pays (ccnl_engine.sickness.agricultural.rules); an episode that does not state them is paid up to 180 days a year with the provisional issue sickness_agricultural_days_unknown, which names the fact.

limitations.summary: A promotion on a day other than the first of a month splits the monthly pay of the run between the level before and the new level by the payable days of the CCNL daily quota on each side of the promotion, component by component, as a month of hire or termination; the hourly quotas of the month read the same split chain. No source sets the split (art. 2103 c.c. gives the higher pay from the assignment): by the maintainer's decision of 2026-11-15 the partial-month rule of the CCNL applies.
limitations.source: c.c. art. 2103; maintainer decision of 2026-11-15; ccnl_engine.compensation.change.rules
limitations.remediation: Resolved by the decision of 2026-11-15: the month is split by the partial-month rule of the CCNL.

limitations.summary: The engine computes the rate of the separate taxation of arrears from PriorYearTaxFacts.net_income_biennio (art. 21 cc. 1, 3 TUIR) and reduces the tax by ArrearsEvent.unused_deductions, the deductions of artt. 12 and 13 cc. 1-2 the worker did not use in the years the arrears refer to (art. 21 c. 4). An arrears event that does not state them, among which the una tantum the engine pays itself, is taxed without the reduction, so the tax may be overstated.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.variable_pay.arrears.handlers._handle_arrears; art. 21 TUIR (Normattiva, text in force from 31-12-2024 to 31-12-2026, page sha256 9638f2c5aec6e3615193a672b6d07c3cd31083640b1c890b73022aa9951745f1)
limitations.remediation: Resolved: art. 21 c. 4 TUIR (Normattiva, https://www.normattiva.it/uri-res/N2Ls?urn:nir:stato:decreto.del.presidente.della.repubblica:1986-12-22;917~art21!vig=, sha256 aafc3e5d5cd7254c7eb52e74051e86f1243b3a7b3cbadcd951daf7bc5e113fc6): 'Gli aventi diritto agli arretrati devono dichiarare al soggetto che li corrisponde l'ammontare delle detrazioni fruite per ciascuno degli anni cui si riferiscono'. The deductions are a fact the worker declares: ArrearsEvent.unused_deductions, and PriorYearTaxFacts.arrears_unused_deductions for the una tantum the engine pays as arrears; unstated, the run carries the missing-fact issue arrears_unused_deductions_unknown. Read on 2026-11-14.

limitations.summary: The una tantum of a renewal is paid from the CCNL data with readings no text read settles in full: a month of service in the covered period counts with the days of the una tantum (15 when the text is silent), over the months of the period; the absences of a month do not reduce it, though a text may pay the months 'di effettiva prestazione'; a part time is paid in proportion to its hours; a run without the employment period is paid none; the share of the covered months of earlier years is taxed apart as arrears.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.compensation.una_tantum.rules.una_tantum_events; CCNL agenti immobiliari FIAIP 19 May 2025 art. 163 (pp. 97-98, sha256 560d16410d3e41dc0bfb00bfe2a40ef65f2cd900234aeaee92018ed9fa21ead5)
limitations.remediation: Source the counting of the months, the part time and the taxation of each una tantum from its agreement, then resolve this limitation.

limitations.summary: L. 260/1949 art. 5 pays the workers with a fixed salary a further daily quota only for the civil holidays (25 April, 1 May, 2 June) falling on a Sunday; the other holidays of art. 2 (1 January, 6 January, Easter Monday, 15 August, 4 October, 1 November, 8 December, 25 and 26 December) give it only by CCNL clause, and the payment of 4 November is a CCNL institute. A run of a month with such a holiday on a Sunday, in a CCNL whose clause is not sourced (work_rules.sunday_holidays), pays the statutory holidays only; a public employment is paid as a private one (art. 5 names the "Stato, enti pubblici e datori privati").
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.compensation.sunday_holiday.services.sunday_holiday; L. 260/1949 artt. 2 and 5 (Normattiva, art. 2 page sha256 42631c3dd629fe3a1c5e10efc7e3b7b86bb5a2b5325024aa4105eaadfcb49828, art. 5 page sha256 dbd670c663744af9); L. 54/1977 art. 1 (page sha256 cde3b9773f4411d28334a85bebdf9358fc4c161d745772df70f38bc79f48d09e)
limitations.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on the holidays falling on a Sunday and record it as work_rules.sunday_holidays.

limitations.summary: A first- or third-level apprentice (D.Lgs. 81/2015 artt. 43 and 45) is paid by the CCNL dual_apprenticeship tracks. The INPS contributions of a third-level apprentice are those of the professionalising one (L. 296/2006 art. 1 c. 773); a first-level one pays the employer 5% (D.Lgs. 150/2015 art. 32 c. 1 lett. b, made structural by L. 205/2017 art. 1 c. 110), the 1.5% and 3% of a firm with up to nine employees staying in the first two years, with no NASpI, no 0.30% (lett. c) and no dismissal contribution (lett. a): INPS circ. 108/2018 par. 3.4 (HTML sha256 6704846f...).
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.apprenticeship.dual.rules.dual_chain
limitations.remediation: Resolved: the first-level rates of INPS circ. 108/2018 par. 3.4 (first_level_employer_rate) and no dismissal contribution; the hours of the final settlement are dual_final_settlement_hours (review of 2026-11-16).

limitations.summary: A final-settlement run of a first- or third-level apprentice pays both its month and the ratei of the extra months: Apprentice.hours weighs both by one set of hours, while the ratei accrued over the year at its own share of school, training and work.
limitations.source: ccnl_engine.apprenticeship.dual.rules.dual_chain
limitations.remediation: Give a final-settlement run separate hours for its month and its ratei.

limitations.summary: A worker first employed after D.Lgs. 252/2005 came into force may deduct, in the twenty years after the fifth year of membership, the contributions above the annual cap within the room the first five years left, up to half the annual cap (art. 8 c. 6). The withholding agent applies it (AdE circ. 70/E/2007: the employer excludes the deductible contributions from the income of the ritenute): the worker states the deduction of the year as PensionFundEnrolment.extra_deduction, and contributions above the cap left with none stated carry the missing fact extra_deduction.
limitations.source: D.Lgs. 252/2005 art. 8 c. 6; AdE circ. 70/E/2007; ccnl_engine.pension_fund.services.extra_deduction_issue
limitations.remediation: Resolved: the extra deduction is an input of the enrolment.
